description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class for an OpenCart extension dashboard map. It contains methods for rendering the dashboard page, saving configuration settings, and returning map data via AJAX endpoints.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: A controller class for managing the dashboard map extension in OpenCart, providing interface for rendering the map, saving settings, and retrieving map data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main dashboard map page with breadcrumbs, configuration options, and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to save map configuration settings and returns success or error as JSON.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns the HTML view for the dashboard map info section.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Fetches total order data by country, formats it as JSON, and returns it for display on the map.
